overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by asking questions of property owners during an unnoticed on-site inspection, which was deliberation outside a meeting; the Town Counsel complaint was declined.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board deliberated during an unnoticed on-site inspection of a property (Wellspring Farm) in August 2016.
allegations.key_passage: asking questions of the property owners during the inspection, the Board improperly deliberated outside of a meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged Town Counsel suppressed public discussion of a particular item during the Board's August 15 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Even if true, this allegation would not constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements
Create minutes of the August 26 on-site inspection within 30 days of receipt of the determination
remedy_passage: we order the Board to create minutes of the August 26 on-site inspection within 30 days of receipt of this determination.
